notes: AC6 from br-improvement-catalog-23b.12 expected ≥50% improvement; actual measurement shows -98.7% (batch is 2x slower).
Root cause: SQLite in-memory indexed point lookups (loop) are faster than window fn sort pass (batch) at N=100 result entries.
The batch impl is architecturally correct (avoids N>999 per-stmt limit) and scales better for large result sets.
Perf advantage only materialises when per-query round-trip cost is significant or N >> 500.
Loop baseline: ~9ms (100 queries x ~0.09ms each). Batch: ~17ms (1 query with window fn on 2000 rows).
